seo__search_description: Bring your team to Oakdene House Foundation for corporate volunteering days or community partnerships. Based in Fairfield, Western Sydney.
hero__intro: A practical way for organisations to support the local community with purpose and impact.
overview__heading: Make it meaningful for your team
overview__text: Corporate volunteering offers organisations a practical way to support the local community while building team connection and purpose. Oakdene House can work with businesses and groups to create volunteering opportunities that are useful, well-organised and meaningful.
overview__text_2: Whether it is a one-day volunteering event or an ongoing partnership, we will work with you to find the right fit.
overview__text_3: If your organisation is interested in supporting Oakdene House through volunteering or partnership, please contact us to discuss suitable options.
why_partner_with_oakdene__text: Oakdene House has served the Fairfield community since 2011, with a strong track record of practical and respectful support.
why_partner_with_oakdene__text_2: We work with your organisation to ensure volunteering days are well-organised, rewarding, and genuinely useful.
why_partner_with_oakdene__text_3: Working together on something meaningful builds team morale and a shared sense of purpose beyond the workplace.
cta__subheading: Contact our team to discuss how your organisation can get involved.
data__opportunities: Donation drives or practical project support
Partnership opportunities linked to skills or service delivery
